financial_base.basis: Consensus FY2026E diluted EPS, Street/non-GAAP basis
financial_base.normalization_note: Consensus FY2026E EPS $29.03 (tenetinvesting, 42 analysts, Street/non-GAAP basis, as of 2026-11-24). Cross-checked vs StockAnalysis/S&P Global FY2026E $29.36 (non-GAAP, 2026-11-25) and WSJ FY2026 $31.19; spread ~7% reflects GAAP-vs-adjusted and contributor differences. Prior normalized tax-adjusted FY2026E ~$26.6 (effective tax 1.9% vs guided 15-17%) not re-derived for want of fresh tax data; using consensus $29.03 as the verifiable base, noting tax-normalization downside risk. Prior record: EPS TTM GAAP $29.33 (17-nov-2026), FY2027E $35.59 (S&P Global).
